2609.24969.title: Rare Event Estimation via Iterative Unalignment
2609.24969.paper_summary: As agents are deployed with increased autonomy, even extremely rare events along their stochastic output trajectories can occur and prove catastrophic. Safe deployment therefore does not depend on whether these events can occur, but on how often they might. We study the problem of estimating the probability of rare events that arise from stochastic variation in the agent's own actions. Estimating this type of risk requires searching over the combinatorially vast space of trajectories. Naive Monte Carlo is computationally prohibitive in this regime, and constructing effective importance sampling (IS) proposals requires coordinated changes to a context-dependent chain of conditional distributions. We develop a new IS method that perturbs the original model's weights to construct the proposal. The proposal is itself a differentiably parameterized language model, enabling gradient-based search over weight space. We formulate an objective that combines a differentiable surrogate for event amplification and an adaptive regularization scheme that dynamically balances amplification against estimator stability. We evaluate our approach on $\sim$120M and $\sim$2.6B models across three event families spanning 300+ rare events as rare as $10^{-9}$, with reference probabilities computed with $<10\%$ relative standard error. In our most verifiable settings, we observe that our IS estimator achieves over $800\times$ compute-weighted efficiency gains over naive Monte Carlo for events with probabilities lower than $10^{-7}$. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/namkoong-lab/iterative-unalignment.
2609.24969.paper_summary_zh: 隨著代理人以更高的自主性被部署，即使在其隨機輸出軌跡上極為罕見的事件也可能發生並造成災難。因此，安全部署不依賴於這些事件是否會發生，而是取決於它們發生的頻率。我們研究了估計由代理人自身行為的隨機變化引起的罕見事件的概率問題。估計這種類型的風險需要在組合上廣大的軌跡空間中進行搜索。在這種情況下，天真的蒙特卡羅方法在計算上是不可行的，而構建有效的重要性抽樣（IS）提案需要對依賴於上下文的條件分佈鏈進行協調變更。我們開發了一種新的IS方法，通過擾動原始模型的權重來構建提案。該提案本身是一個可微分參數化的語言模型，使得在權重空間上進行基於梯度的搜索成為可能。我們制定了一個目標，結合了事件放大的可微分替代物和一個自適應正則化方案，動態平衡放大與估計器穩定性。我們在約1.2億和約26億模型上評估我們的方法，涵蓋三個事件家族，涉及300多個罕見事件，罕見程度低至$10^{-9}$，參考概率的相對標準誤差計算小於10%。在我們最可驗證的設置中，我們觀察到我們的IS估計器在概率低於$10^{-7}$的事件上實現了超過$800\times$的計算加權效率增益，與天真的蒙特卡羅方法相比。我們的實現可在https://github.com/namkoong-lab/iterative-unalignment上獲得。
